CITY OF SAN MARINO

  CITY COUNCIL AGENDA

Susan Jakubowski, Mayor  www.cityofsanmarino.org
Steve Talt, Vice Mayor  (626) 300-0700 Phone
Steven W. Huang, DDS, Council Member  (626) 300-0709 Fax
Gretchen Shepherd Romey, Council Member  City Hall Council Chamber
Ken Ude, Council Member  2200 Huntington Drive
Marcella Marlowe, Ph.D., City Manager  San Marino, CA 91108

  ADJOURNED MEETING
  OF THE SAN MARINO CITY COUNCIL
  FRIDAY, FEBRUARY 25, 2022 AT 8:30 A.M.
  SAN MARINO CENTER
  1800 HUNTINGTON DRIVE
  SAN MARINO, CA 91108

The City of San Marino appreciates your attendance. Citizens’ interest provides the Council with
valuable information regarding issues of the community.

Regular meetings are held on the 2nd Wednesday of every month at 6:00 p.m. Typically, adjourned
meetings are held on the last Friday of every month at 8:30 a.m.

In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, any person with a disability who requires
a reasonable modification or accommodation in order to participate in a meeting should contact
the City Clerk via email at cityclerk@cityofsanmarino.org or by phone at (626) 300-0705 prior
to the meeting for assistance.

  PURSUANT TO ASSEMBLY BILL (AB) 361
Members of the City Council may teleconference into the meeting without noticing each
teleconference location from which a member will be participating in a public meeting.

  CORONAVIRUS DISEASE (COVID-19) ADVISORY
To protect both staff, our constituents, and elected officials, members of the public must follow
the State and County Health Department’s current Health Officer Orders, which require wearing
a mask indoors. Given the seriousness of COVID-19, you are encouraged to watch or listen to
the meeting from home, or provide input electronically, if you do not feel comfortable attending
in person.
 CITY COUNCIL AGENDA – FEBRUARY 25, 2022  PAGE 2 OF 4

How to participate in the meeting from home:
  1) Via Computer for Video Streaming:
  Website: https://us02web.zoom.us/j/89702533880
  Meeting ID: 897 0253 3880
  2) Via Phone for Audio Only:
  Phone Number: (669) 900-9128
  Meeting ID: 897 0253 3880
  Submit Public Comments via email:
  Email: cityclerk@cityofsanmarino.org

How to offer public comment from home:

  1) Public comment will be accepted by email to cityclerk@cityofsanmarino.org until 3:00
  p.m. the day before the meeting, to be read by the City Clerk during public comment.
  Lengthy public comment may be summarized in the interest of time. Any comments
  received after 3:00 p.m. will be included in the public comment record but will not be
  read at the meeting.
  2) Public comment will be accepted electronically via the zoom.us teleconference module
  during the meeting. Zoom comments will be taken after the in-person comments.

CALL TO ORDER

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

ROLL CALL:  Council Member Huang, Council Member Shepherd Romey, Council
  Member Ude, Vice Mayor Talt, and Mayor Jakubowski

POSTING OF AGENDA

The agenda is posted 72 hours prior to each regular meeting at the following locations: City Hall,
2200 Huntington Drive, the Crowell Public Library, 1890 Huntington Drive, and the Stoneman
Building, 1560 Pasqualito Drive.  The agenda is also posted on the City’s website:
http://www.cityofsanmarino.org.

PUBLIC COMMENTS

The City welcomes public input. Members of the public may address the City Council by
completing a public comment card and giving it to the City Clerk prior to the meeting. At this
time, the public may address the City Council on items that are not on the agenda. Pursuant to
state law, the City Council may not discuss or take action on issues not on the meeting agenda
(Government Code Section 54954.2). The Mayor reserves the right to place limits on duration
of comments. Staff may be asked to follow up on such items.
 CITY COUNCIL AGENDA – FEBRUARY 25, 2022  PAGE 3 OF 4

  NEW BUSINESS

1. SELECTION OF FY 2022-23 BUDGET PRIORITY INITIATIVES

  Recommendation: Staff recommends that the City Council engage in a discussion and give
  direction on which priority initiatives they would like staff to incorporate into the City’s Fiscal
  Year 2022-23 work plan and budget.

2. APPROVAL OF RESOLUTION  NO.  R-22-05  TO  AMEND  CITYWIDE
  FINANCIAL POLICIES

  Recommendation: Staff recommends that the City Council adopt Resolution No. R-22-05
  amending the Citywide Financial Policies.

3. APPROVAL OF THE CALIFORNIA EMPLOYERS’ PENSION PREFUNDING
  TRUST (CEPPT) PARTICIPATION AGREEMENT WITH CALPERS WITH A
  ONE-TIME CONTRIBUTION OF $1,000,000

  Recommendation: Staff recommends that the City Council (1) approve Resolution No. R-22-
  07 approving the CEPPT Participation Agreement with CalPERS for the City to participate in
  the CEPPT, (2) approve Resolution No. R-22-08 authorizing certain positions in the City to
  request disbursements from the CEPPT Trust, (3) authorize staff to file the necessary forms
  with CalPERS, and (4) make a one-time contribution of $1,000,000 to open the CEPPT Section
  115 Trust with CalPERS.

4. AWARD OF THE MULTI-YEAR TREE MAINTENANCE AND PLANTING
  PROGRAM AGREEMENT TO MARIPOSA TREE MANAGEMENT, INC., WITH
  FISCAL YEAR 2021-22 (YEAR 1) CONTRACT AMOUNT OF $229,195 WITH A
  TOTAL 7-YEAR ESTIMATED CONTRACT VALUE OF $3,050,931

  Recommendation: Staff recommends that the City Council award the multi-year tree
  maintenance and planting program agreement to Mariposa Tree Management, Inc., with the
  fiscal year 2021-22 (Year 1) contract amount of $229,195 with subsequent contract fiscal years
  contingent on an appropriation by the City Council, with the City Manager being authorized
  to execute the agreement on behalf of the City, as well as two one year contract extension
  subject to City Council appropriation and satisfactory performance.

5. APPROVAL OF A TEMPORARY CONTRACT HIRING PROGRAM FOR THE
  POLICE DEPARTMENT

  Recommendation: Staff recommends that the City Council approve the Temporary Contract
  Police Hiring Program for the next three years and allocate funding from General Fund
  Reserves each month as needed, not to exceed $130,000 with approval by the City Manager
  following approval by the City Attorney.
 CITY COUNCIL AGENDA – FEBRUARY 25, 2022  PAGE 4 OF 4

  CLOSED SESSION

6. CONFERENCE WITH LEGAL COUNSEL – EXISTING LITIGATION
  Government Code Section 54956.9(d)(1)

  The City Council is meeting with respect to one (1) matter of existing litigation against the
  City.

  Case name: Justin Mi v. City of San Marino
  LASC Case No.: 21STCP01830

7. CONFERENCE WITH LEGAL COUNSEL – ANTICIPATED LITIGATION
  Government Code Section 54956.9(d)(2)

  The City Council is meeting with respect to two (2) matters of significant exposure to
  litigation against the City.

WRITTEN COMMUNICATIONS OR PUBLIC WRITINGS DISTRIBUTED

This is an opportunity to announce any written communications pertaining to the City received
by members of the City Council. All public writings distributed by the City of San Marino to at
least a majority of the City Council regarding any item on this agenda will be made available at
the Public Counter at City Hall located at 2200 Huntington Drive, San Marino, California 91108,
and will also be included in the public agenda packet that will available for review at the City
Council meeting.

PUBLIC COMMENTS

FUTURE AGENDA ITEMS

ADJOURNMENT
